properties.notes: Demolition of the existing care home building and redevelopment of the site comprising the erection of a five storey building providing 50 self-contained flats (4 studios, 11 x 1bed, 23 x 2bed and 12 x 3bed) with associated basement level, car and cycle parking space, bin stores, amenity space and landscaping and subject to a Deed of Agreement dated 25 October 2017 under Section 106 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended
